title: Replace QR code implementation on /qr page with qr-code-styling-based component

requirements.summary: Create a self-contained QRCode React component using qr-code-styling library with customizable size and styling options
acceptanceCriteria: The component is importable as `import { QRCode } from '@/components/shared-assets/qr-code'`.
Passing `size="lg"` renders a QR code of approximately 384px.
Passing `dotsOptions={{ color: '#53389e' }}` renders dots in that color.
Passing `cornersSquareOptions` and `cornersDotOptions` with a color applies those colors to the corner squares and corner dots respectively.
Passing `image` and `imageOptions` embeds the logo image at the specified size and margin.
The QR code re-renders correctly when `value` or `options` props change.
The component does not throw or produce a blank output when `options` is omitted.

file_operations.description: Create a React component that wraps qr-code-styling library. Accept props: value (string), size ('sm' | 'md' | 'lg' mapping to 160/256/384px), and options (optional object supporting image, imageOptions, dotsOptions, cornersSquareOptions, cornersDotOptions). Use useEffect to instantiate QRCodeStyling, append it to a container div ref, and update when props change. Clean up on unmount. Return a div container with appropriate dimensions based on size prop.
Create a barrel export file that re-exports the QRCode component to enable the import path '@/components/shared-assets/qr-code'.

requirements.summary: Replace static QR code image on /qr page with the new QRCode component using styled options
acceptanceCriteria: The `/qr` page renders the QR code using the new `` component, not a static `` tag pointing to the PNG file.
The page still displays the portfolio URL as a clickable anchor link as a fallback.
The page retains its existing noindex/nofollow SEO head behavior.
The rendered QR code is visually styled (colored dots/corners) and not plain black-and-white default styling.

file_operations.description: Replace the static element currently displaying the QR code PNG with the new component imported from '@/components/shared-assets/qr-code'. Set value prop to 'https://dynamic-developer-portfolio-with-public-site-and-a-w6e.caffeine.xyz/', size prop to 'lg', and pass styled options with dotsOptions, cornersSquareOptions, and cornersDotOptions using colors from the portfolio's theme (e.g., accent purple '#53389e'). Retain all existing instructional text, the fallback anchor link, and the page structure. Ensure the QR code container remains centered and responsive.
